title: 2025上海マラソン事前ガイド
claims: Start times are: wheelchair 06:45; invited and qualified athletes plus corrals A and B at 07:00; corral C at 07:10; corrals D and E at 07:20.
The guide, updated on 23 November 2025, gives cut-offs at 5 km 08:05, 10 km 08:50, 15 km 09:35, 20 km 10:20, 25 km 11:00, 30 km 11:45, 35 km 12:30, 40 km 13:15 and the finish at 13:30.
The guide credits the Shanghai Marathon official site as its source.
Race pack collection runs 27-29 November 2025, 09:30-19:30, at the north plaza of the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center, 850 Bocheng Road.
Expo access by metro: Line 8 China Art Museum Exit 3 about 430 m on foot; Line 13 Shibo Avenue Exit 1 about 690 m; Line 7 Yaohua Road Exit 4 about 1.1 km.

Expo access by bus: routes 83 and 1049 to Bocheng Road-Zhoujiadu Road about 64 m; routes 1118 and Pudong 98 to Shibo Avenue-SWEECC Road about 258 m; tourist bus Line 3 to China Art Museum about 377 m.
Expo parking is available at P2 underground via Gate E2 on Zhoujiadu Road, Expo Place underground and River Mall underground.
The organiser will notify runners of race-day weather in advance.
The course map is published by the Shanghai Marathon official site, and the detailed course is subject to publication shortly before the race.
